repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until((#MR_ContactSensor).contactSensor_contact == true)
    fired = false
}
wait until((#MR_ContactSensor).contactSensor_contact == false)
(#MR_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(10 SEC)
(#MR_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate polls the sensor at the start of the 1-second cycle but fails to block on the rising edge. At t=100ms, the contact went false (rising edge), but the candidate's `if` evaluated to false because the sensor was already false when the script started that iteration, so it skipped the body entirely. The IR requires blocking until the edge occurs.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with the standard rising-edge rearming pattern: check `fired` state, block until the condition becomes false (rearm), block until it becomes true (trigger), execute body, and mark fired. This ensures the action fires exactly at the rising edge regardless of when the cycle starts.
